title: Fortresses in the middlegame and ending

D0.outcome: Explains a fortress as a set-up the stronger side cannot break although it is ahead in material.

D1.outcome: Told a material imbalance, builds the fortress set-up and names the squares that must stay covered.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, decides whether to aim for a fortress, and spots an enemy fortress he cannot break.

D3.outcome: Tests a claimed fortress by naming the break that would defeat it and showing it does not work.

conditions: The stronger side has no entry square or breakthrough and the weaker side has a safe waiting move.
contrasts: The set-up has one entry square left uncovered.
The stronger side can force a zugzwang against the set-up.
A position where an exchange sacrifice breaks the set-up trivially.

soft_prereq_notes.PRA.RESIST.D2: the practical side of building a fortress in a worse position

note: Defined with END.FORTRESS (T5); middlegame fortresses are rarer and need engine verification.
